This figure is built from what operators reported, not from a confirmed sale or order — it\'s a real, useful number, but it isn\'t the same as "N% of conversations ended in a confirmed sale."

A conversation with more than one tag counts once per tag it holds, so this column will not sum to the total conversation count above - that is expected, not an error.

A closed flow is not the same as a confirmed booking - a visitor can abandon it, an operator can close the conversation mid-step, or it can finish with every offered time declined. This counts flows that closed, not bookings that were made.

It\'s also worth allowing the app to start automatically, so notifications aren\'t missed right after a restart.
You can change this later in Settings → Operating mode.
This opens this app\'s own battery screen — choose "No restrictions".

On some phones (e.g. Xiaomi/MIUI), App info has a "Pause app activity if unused" option — turning it off is recommended, otherwise notifications may be delayed or not arrive. Android gives no way to read or open this option directly, so this is a recommendation, not a verified fact.

This phone most likely has no separate autostart setting — the general battery settings above are usually enough.
